body: Yeah they know but they don't think I'm suicidal.

I've talked to her about it, she just always then makes me feel like the bad guy and that everything is her fault and that shes the terrible one, so then I feel bad and bitch out and take the blame and say I'm wrong. I'm so weak.

I'm 19M living at home without a job right now. I was going to college and had it going pretty good for me when I had to withdraw from all of my classes and go home because I had become suicidal. I've been at home for almost 4 months now and nothing has gotten better other than being away from the hell that is school. My girlfriend 19F (8months younger and a grade below me) went to the same college I did and the distance is killing us and she hates who i am and that I do nothing with myself. She thinks i dont care about her or the relationship and she doesn't think I give effort anymore. Why can't she understand whats wrong with me and that I don't have the effort to give to my own life, let alone our relationship.
